The British General Nexus Metal 20A 16AX light switch in polished chrome offers reliable control for lighting circuits. This durable metal light switch features a sleek, slim profile with rounded edges, ideal for modern interiors in residential or commercial properties. Its 2-way switching capability allows for operating a single light from 2 x locations, such as at the top and bottom of a staircase. A moisture control gasket is fitted to prevent tarnishing from new plaster, ensuring longevity. Installation is straightforward with supplied fixings and backed-out captive terminal screws, accommodating up to 4mm² cable.
